title: Troubleshooting: QR not scanning
summary: Troubleshooting steps for when a QR code will not scan: check QR validity (generated longer ago than 17), adjust brightness/glare, wipe camera lens and steady/adjust distance, verify print/screen quality, ensure camera permissions, close other camera-using apps, and regenerate if open >17 or shared as a delayed screenshot.
